name: second-agent-skill
description: Cross-harness second agent — delegate code reviews, second opinions, or engineering tasks (write tests, fix bugs, refactor) to another harness, only when that harness is named or /second-agent is invoked explicitly. Adds a /second-agent command that runs review.js (read-only) or agent.js (task delegation) against another harness (Gemini, Codex, Claude, opencode, …).
